whyUs.title: The
whyUs.subtitle: We are not just another ski school. We are a community of passionate instructors dedicated to making your mountain experience unforgettable.

certified.title: Certified Instructors
certified.description: All our instructors are ISIA certified with years of experience teaching skiers of all levels. Learn from the best in Bakuriani.

safety.title: Safety First
safety.description: Your safety is our priority. All instructors are trained in first aid and avalanche safety. We provide comprehensive insurance coverage.

flexible.title: Flexible Scheduling
flexible.description: Book lessons at your convenience. Easy rescheduling up to 24 hours in advance.

personalized.title: Personalized Approach
personalized.description: Every skier is unique. Our instructors tailor their teaching methods to your learning style, goals, and pace for maximum progress.

local.title: Local Expertise
local.description: Our instructors know every slope, powder stash, and hidden gem in Bakuriani. Get insider tips on the best runs for your level.

guarantee.title: Satisfaction Guaranteed
guarantee.description: Not satisfied with your lesson? We will make it right with a free follow-up session. Your happiness is our success metric.

contact.title: Get in
contact.subtitle: Have questions about booking or need help finding the right instructor? We are here to help you plan your perfect ski experience.
